title: Elementary XoP Bounds for the Full Query Range
summary: Elementary Fourier bounds establish two-permutation XoP indistinguishability for only about half the full query range; extending the same method to the full range remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the XOR-of-permutations (XoP) construction formed from two independent random permutations, the available elementary Fourier-analysis bounds establish the relevant indistinguishability result only for query parameters $q \leq 2^{n-1}-1$. The unresolved task is to strengthen those bounds so that the same result holds throughout the full range $q \leq 2^n-1$.

scope.domain: Indistinguishability analysis of XoP formed from two independent random permutations using elementary Fourier methods.
parameters: q: query parameter bounded in the indistinguishability result
n: size exponent determining the current and target query ranges
scope.unresolved_remainder: Strengthen the elementary Fourier-analysis bounds so the same indistinguishability result holds throughout the full range q ≤ 2ⁿ − 1.

citations.label: Tight Indistinguishability Bounds for the XOR of Independent Random Permutations by Fourier Analysis

progress.summary: The source presents this as a limitation of its elementary Fourier-analysis method: a stronger prior theorem reaches the full range, but the paper's own bounds do not.
citation_labels: Itai Dinur et al., Tight Indistinguishability Bounds for the XOR of Independent Random Permutations by Fourier Analysis
